• Churchill Brothers SC vs Mohun Bagan Super Giant || Match Content || Highlights || Match 33 || 22-Nov-2026 || English ||
Five in a row for the Mariners! Watch the big moments as Mohun Bagan Super Giant beat Churchill Brothers SC 2-1 in Fatorda to go back to the top of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27 table.
Jamie Maclaren set up Lallianzuala Chhangte in the first half and Anirudh Thapa in the second. Churchill Brothers kept pushing with 23 shots, and Sebastian Gutierrez's late penalty set up a tense finish, but Mohun Bagan saw it out.
